notes: Weigh hopper WH-P220: 100 kg on 3 x 50 kg load cells, Rice Lake 880 at 10,000 divisions (10 g); fast/slow feed with in-flight compensation gives about +/-20 g.
Tolerance for bin-dosed majors is +/-1 % of target, so the smallest bin dose is 2 x 20 g / 1 % = 4 kg.
Feeder rates are maker-class estimates for a volumetric screw at 30-100 rpm; confirm on the feeder quote with each ingredient's bulk density.
One feeder size (2 in) for every bin so screws, seals and spares are interchangeable; the longest single dose (salt) takes under 8 minutes.
